main.description: An identification suggestion for an existing observation. Used to propose or agree with a taxonomic identification.

occurrence.description: A strong reference (CID + URI) to the occurrence being identified.

scientificName.description: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known (Darwin Core dwc:scientificName).

taxonRank.description: The taxonomic rank of the identification (Darwin Core dwc:taxonRank).

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom for disambiguating homonyms (Darwin Core dwc:kingdom).

taxonID.description: Stable URI for the identified taxon (e.g. a GBIF species URI). Maps to Darwin Core dwc:taxonID.

identificationRemarks.description: DEPRECATED: use identificationRemarksID instead. Explanation or reasoning for this identification (Darwin Core dwc:identificationRemarks). Ignored when identificationRemarksID is also set.

identificationRemarksID.description: AT-URI of a bio.lexicons.temp.v0-1.remark record whose body explains the reasoning for this identification. The remark body maps to Darwin Core dwc:identificationRemarks.
